# d39DuiY9sxtDSiu4LSvS.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

This purpose-built kernel loader creates the \\.\wifis device and accepts encrypted PE images through IOCTL 0x222000. Its worker thread decrypts input with an RC4-like routine using the embedded key dsmjklsafbv, manually maps the supplied PE image, resolves imports and relocations, and transfers execution to the unsigned payload in kernel memory.
- **UUID**: 3207f14b-a66c-4d5e-a5d5-2467ffd58265
- **Created**: 2026-08-29
- **Author**: wwwab
- **Acknowledgement**: wwwab | [@wwwab123](https://twitter.com/@wwwab123)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create wifis binPath= C:\windows\temp\d39DuiY9sxtDSiu4LSvS.sys type= kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start wifis
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Reflectively load and execute an unsigned kernel payload after the loader is installed. | Administrator | Windows 10, Windows 11 |
